subquestions.M1: is flip-point synchrony present in every model family that installs the backdoor
subquestions.M2: is acceleration of the common course independent of synchrony

claim: ASR sharpness comes mainly from synchrony: per-input flip points are packed in a narrow band, and a common course sweeps across it; whether that course accelerates is secondary and varies

excluded.flan_t5: ASR 0 at the dose tested: never installed, no onset, not a no-jump counterexample
excluded.sd35: ASR at the judge floor at 1/5/10%: never installed
excluded.falcon_mamba: installs partially then mostly falls back, non-monotone in dose
excluded.llava_qwenvl: binary per-probe flags only; reported separately for S2, excluded from the tiers

per_input_quantity.language: trigger.margin = logit(target first token) - logit(correct first token)
per_input_quantity.classification: triggered_logits[i, 0] - triggered_logits[i, label_i]; target class 0; probes with label 0 excluded

window: b = first point with ASR >= 0.90; a = last point before b with ASR <= 0.10; p = nearest point <= a - (b - a)

metrics.S1_R_level: W / T, W = 5-95% spread of per-input offsets theta from the additive fit (r2 decomp.d2), T = c(b) - min c up to b
metrics.S2_R_time: W_time / a, W_time = 5-95% spread of per-input first-flip points
metrics.M2_accel: v_in / v_pre with v over [a,b] and [p,a]; D3 = share of inputs whose own in-window slope > 1.5x their pre-window slope (r2 decomp.d3)

M2.acceleration_independent: at least one family steady and at least one accelerates

gates.gate_failed: agreement between flip and x_i > 0 below 0.90; excluded from tiers
gates.no_window: ASR never reaches 0.90; excluded from tiers

prediction.E: mostly accounted; classification families most likely not_accounted (window is 1-2 points at 5-step resolution)
prediction.risk: if >= 2 families fall out through gates or no_window, M1 cannot reach 6/7 and lands on partial

scope_limits: dose, tuning type, task and budget differ across families and are mutually confounded; no cross-family causal attribution
R_level and R_time are within-family dimensionless ratios; absolute values are not compared across families
whether synchrony is carried by one shared feature is M3, not this stage

resources.server_access: read-only; writes nothing into any experiment directory
